text:
Yes. Monzo offers **personal arranged overdrafts** to eligible UK customers.

- **Cost:** variable **19%, 29% or 39% EAR** (the effective annual rate). Your rate depends on your circumstances; Monzo shows your personal rate before you borrow.
- **How interest is charged:** on the amount you’re overdrawn, calculated daily and charged monthly.
- **Extra fees:** Monzo says there are no additional fees for using an arranged overdraft.

You can check your eligibility and rate in the Monzo app; checking eligibility doesn’t affect your credit score. If you go over your limit or become overdrawn without an arranged overdraft, different rules can apply—Monzo’s published information says a monthly cap applies to unarranged-overdraft charges.
